completion_rule: Run exactly ten outer Harmony iterations. Do not use the harmonypy 0.0.10 signed early-stop test and do not claim numerical convergence.
reason: Both strict v1 and objective-only v2 convergence attempts failed. Ten iterations matches the historical/default Harmony budget and supplies a reproducible descriptive sensitivity comparison without tuning to labels or scores.
downstream_policy: Require two fresh processes to produce bitwise-identical embeddings and diagnostics before the unchanged five-seed GenoRefine and frozen evaluation workflow.
reporting: Label every resulting main-table use as fixed-10 descriptive sensitivity, not a convergence-verified primary Harmony result.
